messages:
Leah Gomez: Quick heads-up 1: Partner Axiom asked for a private offer on the cloud marketplace that bundles a hardware/appliance rebate with a 9mo committed consumption. They want a renewal top-up trigger (if they exceed 110% of commit) + joint announcement plan. Need draft by Fri.
Tom Rivers: Noted. Do we have a standard appliance rebate template for marketplace private offers? I think we did something similar with a regional reseller but need to check margins.
Aisha Khan: Legal flag: renewal top-up that charges automatically is risky. We can implement an automated "usage alert + opt-in top-up" flow, but auto-billing at renewal requires explicit consent and clear opt-out windows. Also trademark/logo approvals for co-announcement.
Ben Ortiz: Ops note: we can map SKU to dedicated pool for initial ramp. Recommend fallback to shared pools with rate limiting if dedicated capacity exhausted. Avoid promising "burst guarantee"; use "best-effort capacity for initial 30 days" instead.
Leah Gomez: Proposed commercial structure idea below 1: blend rebate vs discount so partner gets appliance rebate upfront and monthly consumption discount. Draft schedule: 1) Appliance rebate = one-time credit equal to X% of commit (appliance SKU). 2) Consumption discount tiered by monthly run-rate.
Leah Gomez: Quick calc sketch (will refine):
```
commit = 300000  # USD over 9 months
appliance_rebate_pct = 0.10
appliance_credit = commit * appliance_rebate_pct
# remaining credit applied as monthly discount tiers
remaining = commit - appliance_credit
monthly_base = remaining / 9
```
Tom Rivers: For tiers, propose: month1-3 elevated discount (20/15/10) to incent ramp; months 4-9 steady state 8%. Also add a clause: if cumulative usage > 110% before month 9 then send top-up notice and allow partner to convert to higher tier commit (with pro-rated SKU credits).
Aisha Khan: Also recommend: 1) Renewal window: 30d notice with explicit acceptance for any price/commit changes. 2) Data residency and support SLA language must be in marketplace listing. I'll draft legal bullets.
marketplace-bot: created private-offer-draft://axiom-appliance-rebate-v1.json (ID: po-8803) and attached preview link to internal draft folder :white_check_mark:
Ben Ortiz: I'll attach SKU->pool mapping and a short ops runbook: autoscale caps, emergency fallback to shared capacity, and incident contact list. Expect that by EOD.
Leah Gomez: Timeline: Fri - internal pricing + ops draft, Mon - Legal and Marketplace review, Tue - partner review, Wed - lock co-announce assets for embargoed release 10 business days after launch. Can someone own co-sell webinar logistics? @Tom? :raised_hands:
Tom Rivers: I can drive webinar logistics and post-launch field enablement. Will coordinate with Field and Product marketing.
Aisha Khan: I'll prepare the legal checklist and trademark request. Ping me if we need special indemnities or hardware warranty language.
Leah Gomez: Great. Final TODOs: Tom to confirm webinar date, Ben to post SKU mapping, Tom/Leah to finalize discount matrix, Aisha to confirm legal bullets. Quick sync tomorrow 11am if needed. :thumbsup:
